item6.title: Senior Software Engineer
item6.text: On Qeevo’s Platform team, I work on the marketplace, its migration to edge rendering on Cloudflare, and shared SDKs. I helped implement authentication for more than 30 systems.

achievements.edge: Led the architecture for migrating marketplace rendering from AWS EKS to Cloudflare.
achievements.auth: Built a Keycloak-based authentication solution for more than 30 systems.
achievements.marketplace: Evolved marketplace search, offers, checkout, and integrations on the Platform team.
achievements.content: Designed a platform for content, advertising, and events with SDKs for Nuxt, Next.js, and CDN delivery.
achievements.customerData: Designed and implemented a customer data platform running in production.
achievements.media: Co-developed the core of an in-house image transformation and delivery service.
achievements.gateway: Built an enterprise MCP gateway with single sign-on, group permissions, temporary access, and auditing.
achievements.observability: Developed an OpenTelemetry SDK for distributed tracing and correlated logs.

item6.recognition: Best Senior Developer at the Qeevo Tech Awards 2026.1, a shared award with Rodolfo Santos.
item6.executiveRecognition: Recognized by executive leadership for results alongside two colleagues on October 2, 2026.
